content:
**Graninger Farm** is a location in the Toxic Valley region of Appalachia.

This location is what remains of a mostly destroyed farm in the Toxic Valley. Only the Aerosolizer remains operational in the post-apocalypse, as both the farmhouse and nearby shed are in states of disrepair.

The gutted farmhouse sits on the western side of the location. In what used to be a bedroom, there is a floor Safe beside a bed and a non-functioning Ham Radio on a dresser. On the other side of the house is a Cooking Station sitting next to a Mattress and a red chair. An Aerosolizer is east of the house, overlooking a small field of vegetables - six Tato and four Corn plants. Finally, the shed building sits in the south with a rusted car inside it.

Graninger Farm appears in *Fallout 76*.
